reference.configuration: A-II / A26 1917 reference for the catalog A-boat aggregate: 50 m low hull, one funnel, two slender pole masts, compact bridge, two single 88 mm guns and one 450 mm torpedo tube. Catalog armament corrected to this coherent 227-ton configuration. This is not the smaller A-I class with a single 50/52 mm gun and two tubes.
reference.note: Stylized class interpretation guided by catalog dimensions, armament and the linked recognition reference; not an engineering plan or exact reconstruction. Continuous hull/deck surfaces, shaped housings and round fittings are original polygon interpretations of the same documented stations.
